newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gunmen kill four in S.Africa's Zulu province.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill four in S.Africa's Zulu province.

text.p: Gunmen shot dead four brothers in their home in South Africa's politically tense KwaZulu-Natal province on Monday night, police said on Tuesday.
A spokesman said the assailants ordered two women out of a house in Umkomaas, about 40 km (25 miles) south of the port city of Durban, then killed the four men with shotguns and handguns.
The motive for the attack was not known. KwaZulu-Natal has a long history of feuding among political rivals and hostile clans.
Police say more than 5,380 people were murdered in criminal or political violence in the province in the first 10 months of the year. In the same period last year the figure was 6,117.
